segments.vism17:641.5: Taṃ pana nāmañca rūpañca nāmarūpañca nāmarūpanti evaṃ katekasesaṃ chaṭṭhāyatanañca saḷāyatanañca saḷāyatananti evaṃ katekasesasseva saḷāyatanassa paccayoti veditabbaṃ.
segments.vism17:641.7: Yasmā āruppe nāmameva paccayo, tañca chaṭṭhāyatanasseva na aññassa. ‘‘Nāmapaccayā chaṭṭhāyatana’’nti (vibha. 322) hi vibhaṅge vuttaṃ.
segments.vism17:641.8: Tattha siyā – kathaṃ panetaṃ jānitabbaṃ ‘‘nāmarūpaṃ saḷāyatanassa paccayo’’ti?
segments.vism17:641.10: Tassa tassa hi nāmassa rūpassa ca bhāve taṃ taṃ āyatanaṃ hoti, na aññathā.
segments.vism17:641.11: Sā panassa tabbhāvabhāvitā paccayanayasmiṃ yeva āvibhavissati.
segments.vism17:641.13: Paṭisandhiyā pavatte vā, hoti yaṃ yassa paccayo;
segments.vism17:641.14: Yathā ca paccayo hoti, tathā neyyaṃ vibhāvinā.
segments.vism17:641.17: Paccayo sattadhā chadhā, hoti taṃ avakaṃsato.
segments.vism17:641.19: Paṭisandhiyaṃ tāva avakaṃsato sahajātaaññamaññanissayasampayuttavipākaatthiavigatapaccayehi sattadhā nāmaṃ chaṭṭhāyatanassa paccayo hoti.
segments.vism17:641.20: Kiñci panettha hetupaccayena, kiñci āhārapaccayenāti evaṃ aññathāpi paccayo hoti, tassa vasena ukkaṃsāvakaṃso veditabbo.
segments.vism17:641.21: Pavattepi vipākaṃ vuttanayeneva paccayo hoti, itaraṃ pana avakaṃsato vuttappakāresu paccayesu vipākapaccayavajjehi chahi paccayehi paccayo hoti.
segments.vism17:641.22: Kiñci panettha hetupaccayena, kiñci āhārapaccayenāti evaṃ aññathāpi paccayo hoti, tassa vasena ukkaṃsāvakaṃso veditabbo.
segments.vism17:641.25: Āruppato hi aññasmimpi pañcavokārabhave taṃ vipākanāmaṃ hadayavatthuno sahāyaṃ hutvā chaṭṭhassa manāyatanassa yathā āruppe vuttaṃ, tatheva avakaṃsato sattadhā paccayo hoti.
segments.vism17:641.26: Itaresaṃ pana taṃ pañcannaṃ cakkhāyatanādīnaṃ catumahābhūtasahāyaṃ hutvā sahajātanissayavipākavippayuttaatthiavigatavasena chahākārehi paccayo hoti.
segments.vism17:641.27: Kiñci panettha hetupaccayena, kiñci āhārapaccayenāti evaṃ aññathāpi paccayo hoti, tassa vasena ukkaṃsāvakaṃso veditabbo.
segments.vism17:641.28: Pavattepi tathā hoti, pākaṃ pākassa paccayo;
segments.vism17:641.30: Pavattepi hi pañcavokārabhave yathā paṭisandhiyaṃ, tatheva vipākanāmaṃ vipākassa chaṭṭhāyatanassa avakaṃsato sattadhā paccayo hoti.
segments.vism17:641.31: Avipākaṃ pana avipākassa chaṭṭhassa avakaṃsatova tato vipākapaccayaṃ apanetvā chadhā paccayo hoti.
segments.vism17:641.35: Tattheva hi pavatte sesānaṃ cakkhāyatanādīnaṃ pañcannaṃ cakkhupasādādivatthukaṃ itarampi vipākanāmaṃ pacchājātavippayuttaatthiavigatapaccayehi catudhā paccayo hoti.
segments.vism17:641.36: Yathā ca vipākaṃ, avipākampi evameva pakāsitaṃ.
segments.vism17:641.37: Tasmā kusalādibhedampi tesaṃ catudhā paccayo hotīti veditabbaṃ.
segments.vism17:641.38: Evaṃ tāva nāmameva paṭisandhiyaṃ pavatte vā yassa yassa āyatanassa paccayo hoti, yathā ca paccayo hoti, tathā veditabbaṃ.
segments.vism17:641.39: Rūpaṃ panettha āruppe, bhave bhavati paccayo;
segments.vism17:641.41: Rūpato sandhiyaṃ vatthu, chadhā chaṭṭhassa paccayo;
segments.vism17:641.43: Rūpato hi paṭisandhiyaṃ vatthurūpaṃ chaṭṭhassa manāyatanassa sahajātaaññamaññanissayavippayuttaatthiavigatapaccayehi chadhā paccayo hoti.
segments.vism17:641.44: Cattāri pana bhūtāni avisesato paṭisandhiyaṃ pavatte ca yaṃ yaṃ āyatanaṃ uppajjati, tassa tassa vasena pañcannampi cakkhāyatanādīnaṃ sahajātanissayaatthiavigatapaccayehi catudhā paccayā honti.
segments.vism17:641.46: Tāneva chadhā chaṭṭhassa, vatthu tasseva pañcadhā.
segments.vism17:641.47: Etesaṃ pana cakkhādīnaṃ pañcannaṃ paṭisandhiyaṃ pavatte ca atthi avigataindriyavasena rūpajīvitaṃ tidhā paccayo hoti.
segments.vism17:641.48: Āhāro ca atthiavigatāhāravasena tividhā paccayo hoti, so ca kho ye sattā āhārūpajīvino, tesaṃ āhārānugate kāye pavattiyaṃyeva, no paṭisandhiyaṃ.
segments.vism17:641.49: Tāni pana pañca cakkhāyatanādīni chaṭṭhassa cakkhu sotaghānajivhākāyaviññāṇasaṅkhātassa manāyatanassa nissayapurejātaindriyavippayuttaatthiavigatavasena chahākārehi paccayā honti pavatte, no paṭisandhiyaṃ.
segments.vism17:641.50: Ṭhapetvā pana pañcaviññāṇāni tasseva avasesamanāyatanassa vatthurūpaṃ nissayapurejātavippayuttaatthiavigatavasena pañcadhā paccayo hoti pavatteyeva, no paṭisandhiyaṃ.
segments.vism17:641.51: Evaṃ rūpameva paṭisandhiyaṃ pavatte vā yassa yassa āyatanassa paccayo hoti, yathā ca paccayo hoti, tathā veditabbaṃ.
segments.vism17:641.52: Nāmarūpaṃ panubhayaṃ, hoti yaṃ yassa paccayo;
segments.vism17:641.53: Yathā ca tampi sabbattha, viññātabbaṃ vibhāvinā.
segments.vism17:641.55: Paṭisandhiyaṃ tāva pañcavokārabhave khandhattayavatthurūpasaṅkhātaṃ nāmarūpaṃ chaṭṭhāyatanassa sahajātaaññamaññanissayavipākasampayuttavippayuttaatthiavigatapaccayādīhi paccayo hotīti.
segments.vism17:641.57: Vuttanayānusārena pana sakkā sabbaṃ yojetunti na ettha vitthāro dassitoti.
segments.vism17:642.4: Saṅkhepena hi saḷāyatanapaccayā phassoti cakkhusamphasso, sotasamphasso, ghānasamphasso, jivhāsamphasso, kāyasamphasso, manosamphassoti ime cakkhusamphassādayo cha eva phassā bhavanti.
segments.vism17:642.5: Vitthārena pana cakkhusamphassādayo pañca kusalavipākā, pañca akusalavipākāti dasa, sesā bāvīsati-lokiyavipākaviññāṇasampayuttā ca bāvīsatīti evaṃ sabbepi saṅkhārapaccayā vuttaviññāṇamiva bāttiṃsa honti.
segments.vism17:642.6: Yaṃ panetassa bāttiṃsavidhassāpi phassassa paccayo saḷāyatanaṃ, tattha,
segments.vism17:642.9: Tattha ye tāva ‘‘upādiṇṇakapavattikathā aya’’nti sakasantatipariyāpannameva paccayaṃ paccayuppannañca dīpenti, te ‘‘chaṭṭhāyatanapaccayā phasso’’ti (vibha. 322) pāḷianusārato āruppe chaṭṭhāyatanañca, aññattha sabbasaṅgahato saḷāyatanañca phassassa paccayoti ekadesasarūpekasesaṃ katvā chaṭṭhena saha ajjhattaṃ cakkhādiṃ saḷāyatananti icchanti.
segments.vism17:642.10: Tañhi chaṭṭhāyatanañca saḷāyatanañca saḷāyatanantveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
segments.vism17:642.11: Ye pana paccayuppannameva ekasantatipariyāpannaṃ dīpenti, paccayaṃ pana bhinnasantānampi, te yaṃ yaṃ āyatanaṃ phassassa paccayo hoti, taṃ sabbampi dīpentā bāhirampi pariggahetvā tadeva chaṭṭhena saha ajjhattaṃ bāhirehipi rūpāyatanādīhi saddhiṃ saḷāyatananti icchanti.
segments.vism17:642.12: Tampi hi chaṭṭhāyatanañca saḷāyatanañca saḷāyatananti etesaṃ ekasese kate saḷāyatanantveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
segments.vism17:642.13: Etthāha – na sabbāyatanehi eko phasso sambhoti, nāpi ekamhā āyatanā sabbe phassā, ayañca saḷāyatanapaccayā phassoti ekova vutto, so kasmāti.
segments.vism17:642.14: Tatridaṃ vissajjanaṃ – saccametaṃ, sabbehi eko, ekamhā vā sabbe na sambhonti, sambhoti pana anekehi eko.
segments.vism17:642.15: Yathā cakkhusamphasso cakkhāyatanā rūpāyatanā cakkhuviññāṇasaṅkhātā manāyatanā avasesasampayuttadhammāyatanā cāti evaṃ sabbattha yathānurūpaṃ yojetabbaṃ.
segments.vism17:642.19: Ekavacananiddesenāti saḷāyatanapaccayā phassoti iminā ekavacananiddesena anekehi āyatanehi eko phasso hotīti tādinā dīpitoti attho.
segments.vism17:642.21: Chadhā pañca tato ekaṃ, navadhā bāhirāni cha;
segments.vism17:642.23: Tatrāyaṃ vibhāvanā – cakkhāyatanādīni tāva pañca cakkhusamphassādibhedato pañcavidhassa phassassa nissayapurejātindriyavippayuttaatthiavigatavasena chadhā paccayā honti.
segments.vism17:642.24: Tato paraṃ ekaṃ vipākamanāyatanaṃ anekabhedassa vipākamanosamphassassa sahajātaaññamaññanissayavipākāhāraindriyasampayuttaatthiavigatavasena navadhā paccayo hoti.
segments.vism17:642.25: Bāhiresu pana rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhusamphassassa ārammaṇapurejātaatthiavigatavasena catudhā paccayo hoti.
segments.vism17:642.27: Manosamphassassa pana tāni ca dhammāyatanañca tathā ca ārammaṇapaccayamatteneva cāti evaṃ bāhirāni cha yathāsambhavametassa paccayatte vibhāvayeti.
segments.vism17:643.5: Sota… ghāna… jivhā… kāya… manosamphassajā vedanā’’ti (vibha. 231) evaṃ dvārato saḷeva vedanā vuttā, tā pana pabhedena ekūnanavutiyā cittehi sampayuttattā ekūnanavuti matā.
segments.vism17:643.9: Sesānaṃ ekadhā phasso, manodvārepi so tathā.
segments.vism17:643.10: Tattha hi pañcadvāre cakkhupasādādivatthukānaṃ pañcannaṃ vedanānaṃ cakkhusamphassādiko phasso sahajātaaññamaññanissayavipākaāhārasampayuttaatthiavigatavasena aṭṭhadhā paccayo hoti.
segments.vism17:643.11: Sesānaṃ pana ekekasmiṃ dvāre sampaṭicchanasantīraṇatadārammaṇavasena pavattānaṃ kāmāvacaravipākavedanānaṃ so cakkhusamphassādiko phasso upanissayavasena ekadhāva paccayo hoti.
segments.vism17:643.12: Manodvārepi so tathāti manodvārepi hi tadārammaṇavasena pavattānaṃ kāmāvacaravipākavedanānaṃ so sahajātamanosamphassasaṅkhāto phasso tatheva aṭṭhadhā paccayo hoti, paṭisandhibhavaṅgacutivasena pavattānaṃ tebhūmakavipākavedanānampi.
segments.vism17:643.13: Yā pana tā manodvāre tadārammaṇavasena pavattā kāmāvacaravedanā, tāsaṃ manodvārāvajjanasampayutto manosamphasso upanissayavasena ekadhāva paccayo hotīti.
segments.vism17:644.4: Imasmiṃ hi pade seṭṭhiputto brāhmaṇaputtoti pitito nāmavasena putto viya ‘‘rūpataṇhā.
segments.vism17:644.5: Sadda… gandha… rasa… phoṭṭhabba… dhammataṇhā’’ti (vibha. 232) ārammaṇato nāmavasena vibhaṅge cha taṇhā dīpitā.
segments.vism17:644.6: Tāsu pana taṇhāsu ekekā taṇhā pavattiākārato kāmataṇhā, bhavataṇhā, vibhavataṇhāti evaṃ tividhā matā.
segments.vism17:644.7: Rūpataṇhāyeva hi yadā cakkhussa āpāthamāgataṃ rūpārammaṇaṃ kāmassādavasena assādayamānā pavattati, tadā kāmataṇhā nāma hoti.
segments.vism17:644.8: Yadā tadevārammaṇaṃ ‘‘dhuvaṃ sassata’’nti pavattāya sassatadiṭṭhiyā saddhiṃ pavattati, tadā bhavataṇhā nāma hoti.
segments.vism17:644.10: Yadā pana tadevārammaṇaṃ ‘‘ucchijjati vinassatī’’ti pavattāya ucchedadiṭṭhiyā saddhiṃ pavattati, tadā vibhavataṇhā nāma hoti.
segments.vism17:644.14: Tā ajjhattarūpādīsu aṭṭhārasa, bahiddhā aṭṭhārasāti chattiṃsa.
segments.vism17:644.15: Iti atītā chattiṃsa, anāgatā chattiṃsa, paccuppannā chattiṃsāti aṭṭhasataṃ taṇhā honti.
segments.vism17:644.16: Tā puna saṅkheppamāṇā rūpādiārammaṇavasena cha, kāmataṇhādivasena vā tissova taṇhā hontīti veditabbā.
segments.vism17:644.17: Yasmā panime sattā puttaṃ assādetvā putte mamattena dhātiyā viya rūpādiārammaṇavasena uppajjamānaṃ vedanaṃ assādetvā vedanāya mamattena rūpādiārammaṇadāyakānaṃ cittakāra-gandhabba-gandhika-sūda-tantavāyarasāyanavidhāyakavejjādīnaṃ mahāsakkāraṃ karonti.
segments.vism17:644.18: Tasmā sabbāpesā vedanāpaccayā taṇhā hotīti veditabbā.
segments.vism17:644.23: Dukkhī sukhaṃ patthayati, sukhī bhiyyopi icchati;
segments.vism17:644.25: Taṇhāya paccayā tasmā, honti tissopi vedanā;
segments.vism17:644.28: Hoti tasmā na sā hoti, brāhmaṇassa vusīmatoti.
segments.vism17:645.4: Tatrāyaṃ vibhāvanā – kāmupādānaṃ, diṭṭhupādānaṃ, sīlabbatupādānaṃ, attavādupādānanti imāni tāvettha cattāri upādānāni.
segments.vism17:645.5: Tesaṃ ayaṃ atthavibhāgo – vatthusaṅkhātaṃ kāmaṃ upādiyatīti kāmupādānaṃ, kāmo ca so upādānañcātipi kāmupādānaṃ.
segments.vism17:645.9: Diṭṭhiṃ upādiyatīti vā diṭṭhupādānaṃ. ‘‘Sassato attā ca loko cā’’tiādīsu (dī. ni. 1.31) hi purimadiṭṭhiṃ uttaradiṭṭhi upādiyati.
segments.vism17:645.12: Gosīlagovatādīni hi ‘‘evaṃ suddhī’’ti abhinivesato sayameva upādānāni.
segments.vism17:645.18: Attavādamattameva vā attāti upādiyanti etenāti attavādupādānaṃ.
segments.vism17:645.21: Yo kāmesu kāmacchando kāmarāgo kāmanandī kāmataṇhā kāmasneho kāmapariḷāho kāmamucchā kāmajjhosānaṃ, idaṃ vuccati kāmupādāna’’nti (dha. sa. 1220; vibha. 938) āgatattā saṅkhepato taṇhādaḷhattaṃ vuccati.
segments.vism17:645.23: Keci panāhu ‘‘appattavisayapatthanā taṇhā andhakāre corassa hatthappasāraṇaṃ viya, sampattavisayaggahaṇaṃ upādānaṃ tasseva bhaṇḍaggahaṇaṃ viya.
segments.vism17:645.27: Vitthārato pana pubbe rūpādīsu vuttaaṭṭhasatappabhedāyapi taṇhāya daḷhabhāvo kāmupādānaṃ.
segments.vism17:645.30: Natthi dinnaṃ, natthi yiṭṭhaṃ…pe… sacchikatvā pavedentīti yā evarūpā diṭṭhi…pe… vipariyesaggāho.
segments.vism17:645.34: Sīlena suddhi, vatena suddhi, sīlabbatena suddhīti yā evarūpā diṭṭhi…pe… vipariyesaggāho.
segments.vism17:645.38: Idha assutavā puthujjano…pe… sappurisadhamme avinīto rūpaṃ attato samanupassati…pe… vipariyesaggāho, idaṃ vuccati attavādupādāna’’nti (dha. sa. 1223; vibha. 938).
segments.vism17:645.40: Kamatoti ettha pana tividho kamo uppattikkamo pahānakkamo desanākkamo ca.
segments.vism17:645.41: Tattha anamatagge saṃsāre imassa paṭhamaṃ uppattīti abhāvato kilesānaṃ nippariyāyena uppattikkamo na vuccati.
segments.vism17:645.42: Pariyāyena pana yebhuyyena ekasmiṃ bhave attaggāhapubbaṅgamo sassatucchedābhiniveso, tato ‘‘sassato ayaṃ attā’’ti gaṇhato attavisuddhatthaṃ sīlabbatupādānaṃ, ‘‘ucchijjatī’’ti gaṇhato paralokanirapekkhassa kāmupādānanti evaṃ paṭhamaṃ attavādupādānaṃ, tato diṭṭhisīlabbatakāmupādānānīti ayametesaṃ ekasmiṃ bhave uppattikkamo.
segments.vism17:645.45: Mahāvisayattā pana pākaṭattā ca etesu kāmupādānaṃ paṭhamaṃ desitaṃ.
segments.vism17:645.46: Mahāvisayaṃ hi taṃ aṭṭhacittasampayogā, appavisayāni itarāni catucittasampayogā, yebhuyyena ca ālayarāmattā pajāya pākaṭaṃ kāmupādānaṃ, na itarāni.
segments.vism17:645.47: Kāmupādāna vā kāmānaṃ samadhigamatthaṃ kotūhalamaṅgalādibahulo hoti, sāssa diṭṭhīti tadanantaraṃ diṭṭhupādānaṃ, taṃ pabhijjamānaṃ sīlabbataattavādupādānavasena duvidhaṃ hoti.
segments.vism17:645.48: Tasmiṃ dvaye gokiriyaṃ kukkurakiriyaṃ vā disvāpi veditabbato oḷārikanti sīlabbatupādānaṃ paṭhamaṃ desitaṃ.
segments.vism17:645.50: Taṇhā ca purimassettha, ekadhā hoti paccayo;
segments.vism17:645.51: Sattadhā aṭṭhadhā vāpi, hoti sesattayassa sā.
segments.vism17:645.52: Ettha ca evaṃ desite upādānacatukke purimassa kāmupādānassa kāmataṇhā upanissayavasena ekadhāva paccayo hoti, taṇhābhinanditesu visayesu uppattito.
segments.vism17:645.53: Sesattayassa pana sahajātaaññamaññanissayasampayuttaatthiavigatahetuvasena sattadhā vā, upanissayena saha aṭṭhadhā vāpi paccayo hoti.
segments.vism17:645.54: Yadā ca sā upanissayavasena paccayo hoti, tadā asahajātāva hotīti.
segments.vism17:646.3: Yaṃ yassa paccayo ceva, viññātabbo vinicchayo.
segments.vism17:646.5: So kammabhavo upapattibhavo cāti duvidho hoti.
segments.vism17:646.6: Yathāha – ‘‘bhavo duvidhena atthi kammabhavo, atthi upapattibhavo’’ti (vibha. 234).
segments.vism17:646.7: Tattha kammameva bhavo kammabhavo, tathā upapattiyeva bhavo upapattibhavo.
segments.vism17:646.9: Kammaṃ pana yathā sukhakāraṇattā ‘‘sukho buddhānaṃ uppādo’’ti (dha. pa. 194) vutto, evaṃ bhavakāraṇattā phalavohārena bhavoti veditabbanti.
segments.vism17:647.1: Dhammato pana kammabhavo tāva saṅkhepato cetanā ceva cetanāsampayuttā ca abhijjhādayo kammasaṅkhātā dhammā.
segments.vism17:647.3: Puññābhisaṅkhāro apuññābhisaṅkhāro āneñjābhisaṅkhāro (vibha. 234) parittabhūmako vā mahābhūmako vā, ayaṃ vuccati kammabhavo.
segments.vism17:647.8: Evaṃ parittabhūmako vā mahābhūmako vāti etena tāsaṃyeva cetanānaṃ mandabahuvipākatā vuttā.
segments.vism17:647.9: Sabbampi bhavagāmikammanti iminā pana cetanāsampayuttā abhijjhādayo vuttā.
segments.vism17:647.10: Upapattibhavo pana saṅkhepato kammābhinibbattā khandhā, pabhedato navavidho hoti.
segments.vism17:647.12: Kāmabhavo rūpabhavo arūpabhavo saññābhavo asaññābhavo nevasaññānāsaññābhavo, ekavokārabhavo catuvokārabhavo pañcavokārabhavo, ayaṃ vuccati upapattibhavo’’ti (vibha. 234).
segments.vism17:647.15: Saññāvataṃ bhavo, saññā vā ettha bhave atthīti saññābhavo.
segments.vism17:647.17: Oḷārikāya saññāya abhāvā sukhumāya ca bhāvā nevasaññā, nāsaññā asmiṃ bhaveti nevasaññānāsaññābhavo.
segments.vism17:647.19: Eko vā vokāro assa bhavassāti ekavokārabhavo.
segments.vism17:647.26: Ekavokārabhavādayo ekacatupañcakkhandhā upādiṇṇakkhandhehīti evamettha dhammatopi viññātabbo vinicchayo.
segments.vism17:648.1: Sātthatoti yathā ca bhavaniddese, tatheva kāmaṃ saṅkhāraniddesepi puññābhisaṅkhārādayova vuttā, evaṃ santepi purime atītakammavasena idha paṭisandhiyā paccayattā, ime paccuppannakammavasena āyatiṃ paṭisandhiyā paccayattāti punavacanaṃ sātthakameva, pubbe vā ‘‘tattha katamo puññābhisaṅkhāro?
segments.vism17:648.2: Kusalā cetanā kāmāvacarā’’ti (vibha. 226) evamādinā nayena cetanāva saṅkhārāti vuttā.
segments.vism17:648.6: Kiṃ vā bahunā, ‘‘avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā’’ti ettha puññābhisaṅkhārādayova kusalākusalā dhammā vuttā. ‘‘Upādānapaccayā bhavo’’ti idha pana upapattibhavassāpi saṅgahitattā kusalākusalābyākatā dhammā vuttā.
segments.vism17:648.7: Tasmā sabbathāpi sātthakamevidaṃ punavacananti evamettha sātthatopi viññātabbo vinicchayo.
segments.vism17:649.1: Bhedasaṅgahāti upādānapaccayā bhavassa bhedato ceva saṅgahato ca.
segments.vism17:649.2: Yañhi kāmupādānapaccayā kāmabhavanibbattakaṃ kammaṃ karīyati, so kammabhavo.
segments.vism17:649.5: Evaṃ kāmupādānapaccayā dve kāmabhavā, tadantogadhā ca saññābhavapañcavokārabhavā, dve rūpabhavā, tadantogadhā ca saññābhavaasaññābhavaekavokārabhavapañcavokārabhavā, dve arūpabhavā, tadantogadhā ca saññābhavanevasaññānāsaññābhavacatuvokārabhavāti saddhiṃ antogadhehi cha bhavā.
segments.vism17:649.6: Yathā ca kāmupādānapaccayā saddhiṃ antogadhehi cha bhavā.
segments.vism17:649.7: Tathā sesupādānapaccayāpīti evaṃ upādānapaccayā bhedato saddhiṃ antogadhehi catuvīsati bhavā.
segments.vism17:649.8: Saṅgahato pana kammabhavaṃ upapattibhavañca ekato katvā kāmupādānapaccayā saddhiṃ antogadhehi eko kāmabhavo.
segments.vism17:649.11: Evaṃ upādānapaccayā saṅgahato saddhiṃ antogadhehi dvādasa bhavā.
segments.vism17:649.12: Apica avisesena upādānapaccayā kāmabhavūpagaṃ kammaṃ kammabhavo.
segments.vism17:649.15: Evaṃ upādānapaccayā saddhiṃ antogadhehi dve kāmabhavā, dve rūpabhavā, dve arūpabhavāti aparena pariyāyena saṅgahato cha bhavā.
segments.vism17:649.16: Kammabhavaupapattibhavabhedaṃ vā anupagamma saddhiṃ antogadhehi kāmabhavādivasena tayo bhavā honti.
segments.vism17:649.17: Kāmabhavādibhedampi anupagamma kammabhavaupapattibhavavasena dve bhavā honti.
segments.vism17:649.18: Kammupapattibhedañcāpi anupagamma upādānapaccayā bhavoti bhavavasena ekova bhavo hotīti evamettha upādānapaccayassa bhavassa bhedasaṅgahāpi viññātabbo vinicchayo.
segments.vism17:650.1: Yaṃ yassa paccayo cevāti yañcettha upādānaṃ yassa paccayo hoti, tatopi viññātabbo vinicchayoti attho.
segments.vism17:650.5: So idaṃ yuttaṃ idaṃ ayuttanti avicāretvā yassa kassaci upādānassa vasena yaṃkiñci bhavaṃ patthetvā yaṃkiñci kammaṃ karotiyeva.
segments.vism17:650.6: Tasmā yadekacce sīlabbatupādānena rūpārūpabhavā na hontīti vadanti, taṃ na gahetabbaṃ.
segments.vism17:650.8: Seyyathidaṃ – idhekacco anussavavasena vā diṭṭhānusārena vā ‘‘kāmā nāmete manussaloke ceva khattiyamahāsālakulādīsu, cha kāmāvacaradevaloke ca samiddhā’’ti cintetvā tesaṃ adhigamatthaṃ asaddhammassavanādīhi vañcito ‘‘iminā kammena kāmā sampajjantī’’ti maññamāno kāmupādānavasena kāyaduccaritādīnipi karoti, so duccaritapāripūriyā apāye upapajjati.
segments.vism17:650.9: Sandiṭṭhike vā pana kāme patthayamāno paṭiladdhe ca gopayamāno kāmupādānavasena kāyaduccaritādīni karoti, so duccaritapāripūriyā apāye upapajjati.
segments.vism17:650.13: Aparo pana saddhammassavanādīhi upabrūhitañāṇo ‘‘iminā kammena kāmā sampajjantī’’ti maññamāno kāmupādānavasena kāyasucaritādīni karoti.
segments.vism17:650.14: So sucaritapāripūriyā devesu vā manussesu vā upapajjati.
segments.vism17:650.18: Iti kāmupādānaṃ sappabhedassa sāntogadhassa kāmabhavassa paccayo hoti.
segments.vism17:650.19: Aparo ‘‘rūpārūpabhavesu tato samiddhatarā kāmā’’ti sutvā parikappetvā vā kāmupādānavaseneva rūpārūpasamāpattiyo nibbattetvā samāpattibalena rūpārūpabrahmaloke upapajjati.
segments.vism17:650.23: Iti kāmupādānaṃ sappabhedānaṃ sāntogadhānaṃ rūpārūpabhavānampi paccayo hoti.
segments.vism17:650.24: Aparo ‘‘ayaṃ attā nāma kāmāvacarasampattibhave vā rūpārūpabhavānaṃ vā aññatarasmiṃ ucchinne suucchinno hotī’’ti ucchedadiṭṭhiṃ upādāya tadupagaṃ kammaṃ karoti, tassa taṃ kammaṃ kammabhavo.
segments.vism17:650.27: Iti diṭṭhupādānaṃ sappabhedānaṃ sāntogadhānaṃ tiṇṇampi kāmarūpārūpabhavānaṃ paccayo hoti.
segments.vism17:650.28: Aparo ‘‘ayaṃ attā nāma kāmāvacarasampattibhave vā rūpārūpabhavānaṃ vā aññatarasmiṃ sukhī hoti vigatapariḷāho’’ti attavādupādānena tadupagaṃ kammaṃ karoti, tassa taṃ kammaṃ kammabhavo.
segments.vism17:650.31: Iti attavādupādānaṃ sappabhedānaṃ sāntogadhānaṃ tiṇṇaṃ bhavānaṃ paccayo hoti.
segments.vism17:650.32: Aparo ‘‘idaṃ sīlabbataṃ nāma kāmāvacarasampattibhave vā rūpārūpabhavānaṃ vā aññatarasmiṃ paripūrentassa sukhaṃ pāripūriṃ gacchatī’’ti sīlabbatupādānavasena tadupagaṃ kammaṃ karoti, tassa taṃ kammaṃ kammabhavo.
segments.vism17:650.35: Iti sīlabbatupādānaṃ sappabhedānaṃ sāntogadhānaṃ tiṇṇaṃ bhavānaṃ paccayo hoti.
segments.vism17:650.36: Evamettha yaṃ yassa paccayo hoti, tatopi viññātabbo vinicchayo.
segments.vism17:650.37: Kiṃ panettha kassa bhavassa kathaṃ paccayo hotīti ce?
segments.vism17:650.40: Rūpārūpabhavānaṃ hi, kāmabhavapariyāpannassa ca kammabhave kusalakammasseva, upapattibhavassa cetaṃ catubbidhampi upādānaṃ upanissayapaccayavasena ekadhāva paccayo hoti.
segments.vism17:650.41: Kāmabhave attanā sampayuttākusalakammabhavassa sahajātaaññamaññanissayasampayuttaatthiavigatahetupaccayappabhedehi sahajātādīhi paccayo hoti.
segments.vism17:651.1: Bhavapaccayā jātītiādīsu jātiādīnaṃ vinicchayo saccaniddese vuttanayeneva veditabbo.
segments.vism17:651.3: So hi jātiyā paccayo, na upapattibhavo.
segments.vism17:651.4: So ca pana kammapaccayaupanissayapaccayavasena dvedhā paccayo hotīti.
segments.vism17:651.5: Tattha siyā – kathaṃ panetaṃ jānitabbaṃ bhavo jātiyā paccayoti ce?
segments.vism17:651.7: Bāhirānaṃ hi janakajananīsukkasoṇitāhārādīnaṃ paccayānaṃ samattepi sattānaṃ yamakānampi sataṃ hīnapaṇītatādiviseso dissati.
segments.vism17:651.8: So ca na ahetuko sabbadā ca sabbesañca abhāvato, na kammabhavato aññahetuko tadabhinibbattakasattānaṃ ajjhattasantāne aññassa kāraṇassa abhāvatoti kammabhavahetukova.
segments.vism17:651.10: Tenāha bhagavā ‘‘kammaṃ satte vibhajati yadidaṃ hīnappaṇītatāyā’’ti (ma. ni. 3.289).
segments.vism17:651.12: Yasmā ca asati jātiyā jarāmaraṇaṃ nāma, sokādayo vā dhammā na honti.
segments.vism17:651.13: Jātiyā pana sati jarāmaraṇañceva, jarāmaraṇasaṅkhātadukkhadhammaphuṭṭhassa ca bālajanassa jarāmaraṇābhisambandhā vā tena tena dukkhadhammena phuṭṭhassa anabhisambandhā vā sokādayo ca dhammā honti.
segments.vism17:651.14: Tasmā ayampi jāti jarāmaraṇassa ceva sokādīnañca paccayo hotīti veditabbā.
segments.vism17:651.15: Sā pana upanissayakoṭiyā ekadhāva paccayo hotīti.
segments.vism17:652.1: Yasmā panettha sokādayo avasāne vuttā, tasmā yā sā avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārāti evametassa bhavacakkassa ādimhi vuttā, sā,
segments.vism17:652.5: Kathaṃ panettha sokādīhi avijjā siddhā, kathamidaṃ bhavacakkaṃ aviditādi, kathaṃ kārakavedakarahitaṃ, kathaṃ dvādasavidhasuññatāsuññanti ce?
segments.vism17:652.6: Ettha hi sokadomanassupāyāsā avijjāya aviyogino, paridevo ca nāma mūḷhassāti tesu tāva siddhesu siddhā hoti avijjā.
segments.vism17:652.13: Te kāmā parihāyanti, sallaviddhova ruppatī’’ti. (su. ni. 773);
segments.vism17:652.18: ‘‘Tassa ‘ahaṃ rūpaṃ mama rūpa’nti pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyino rūpavipariṇāmaññathābhāvā uppajjanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā’’ti (saṃ. ni. 3.1).
segments.vism17:652.21: ‘‘Yepi te devā dīghāyukā vaṇṇavanto sukhabahulā uccesu vimānesu ciraṭṭhitikā, tepi tathāgatassa dhammadesanaṃ sutvā bhayaṃ santāsaṃ saṃvegamāpajjantī’’ti (saṃ. ni. 3.78).
segments.vism17:652.22: Pañca pubbanimittāni disvā maraṇabhayena santajjitānaṃ devānaṃ viya.
segments.vism17:652.25: ‘‘Sa kho so, bhikkhave, bālo tividhaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedetī’’ti (ma. ni. 3.246).
segments.vism17:652.26: Iti yasmā āsavasamudayā ete dhammā honti, tasmā ete sijjhamānā avijjāya hetubhūte āsave sādhenti.
segments.vism17:652.27: Āsavesu ca siddhesu paccayabhāve bhāvato avijjāpi siddhāva hotīti.
segments.vism17:652.28: Evaṃ tāvettha sokādīhi avijjā siddhā hotīti veditabbā.
segments.vism17:652.29: Yasmā pana evaṃ paccayabhāve bhāvato avijjāya siddhāya puna avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā, saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇanti evaṃ hetuphalaparamparāya pariyosānaṃ natthi.
segments.vism17:652.30: Tasmā taṃ hetuphalasambandhavasena pavattaṃ dvādasaṅgaṃ bhavacakkaṃ aviditādīti siddhaṃ hoti.
segments.vism17:652.31: Evaṃ sati avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārāti idaṃ ādimattakathanaṃ virujjhatīti ce.
segments.vism17:652.35: Avijjāggahaṇena hi avasesakilesavaṭṭañca kammādīni ca bālaṃ palibodhenti.
segments.vism17:652.37: Avijjāsamucchede pana kate tehi vimokkho hoti.
segments.vism17:652.40: Iti yaṃ gaṇhato bandho, muccato ca mokkho hoti, tassa padhānadhammassa kathanamidaṃ, na ādimattakathananti.
segments.vism17:652.42: Tayidaṃ yasmā avijjādīhi kāraṇehi saṅkhārādīnaṃ pavatti, tasmā tato aññena ‘‘brahmā mahābrahmā seṭṭho sajitā’’ti (dī. ni. 1.42) evaṃ parikappitena brahmādinā vā saṃsārassa kārakena, ‘‘so kho pana me ayaṃ attā vado vedeyyo’’ti evaṃ parikappitena attanā vā sukhadukkhānaṃ vedakena rahitaṃ.
segments.vism17:652.44: Yasmā panettha avijjā udayabbayadhammakattā dhuvabhāvena, saṃkiliṭṭhattā saṃkilesikattā ca subhabhāvena, udayabbayapaṭipīḷitattā sukhabhāvena, paccayāyattavuttittā vasavattanabhūtena attabhāvena ca suññā.
segments.vism17:652.46: Yasmā vā avijjā na attā, na attano, na attani, na attavatī.
segments.vism17:653.3: Dve aṭṭha dve eva ca, sarūpato tesu aṅgāni.
segments.vism17:653.4: Tassa kho panetassa bhavacakkassa avijjā taṇhā cāti dve dhammā mūlanti veditabbā.
segments.vism17:653.5: Tadetaṃ pubbantāharaṇato avijjāmūlaṃ vedanāvasānaṃ, aparantasantānato taṇhāmūlaṃ jarāmaraṇāvasānanti duvidhaṃ hoti.
segments.vism17:653.6: Tattha purimaṃ diṭṭhicaritavasena vuttaṃ, pacchimaṃ taṇhācaritavasena.
segments.vism17:653.7: Diṭṭhicaritānaṃ hi avijjā, taṇhācaritānañca taṇhā saṃsāranāyikā.
segments.vism17:653.8: Ucchedadiṭṭhisamugghātāya vā paṭhamaṃ, phaluppattiyā hetūnaṃ anupacchedappakāsanato, sassatadiṭṭhisamugghātāya dutiyaṃ, uppannānaṃ jarāmaraṇappakāsanato.
segments.vism17:653.9: Gabbhaseyyakavasena vā purimaṃ, anupubbapavattidīpanato, opapātikavasena pacchimaṃ, sahuppattidīpanato.
segments.vism17:653.11: Tesu pāḷiyaṃ sarūpato āgatavasena ‘‘avijjā, saṅkhārā cā’’ti dve aṅgāni atītakālāni.
segments.vism17:654.5: Tattha saṅkhārānañca paṭisandhiviññāṇassa ca antarā eko hetuphalasandhi nāma.
segments.vism17:654.6: Vedanāya ca taṇhāya ca antarā eko phalahetusandhi nāma.
segments.vism17:654.7: Bhavassa ca jātiyā ca antarā eko hetuphalasandhīti evamidaṃ hetuphalahetupubbakatisandhīti veditabbaṃ.
segments.vism17:654.16: Etehi pana vīsatiyā ākārasaṅkhātehi arehi vīsatiākārāranti veditabbaṃ.
segments.vism17:654.17: Tattha atīte hetavo pañcāti avijjā saṅkhārā cāti ime tāva dve vuttā eva.
segments.vism17:654.18: Yasmā pana avidvā paritassati, paritassito upādiyati, tassupādānapaccayā bhavo.
segments.vism17:654.20: Tenāha ‘‘purimakammabhavasmiṃ moho avijjā, āyūhanā saṅkhārā, nikanti taṇhā, upagamanaṃ upādānaṃ, cetanā bhavoti ime pañca dhammā purimakammabhavasmiṃ idha paṭisandhiyā paccayā’’ti (paṭi. ma. 1.47).
segments.vism17:654.21: Tattha purimakammabhavasminti purime kammabhave, atītajātiyaṃ kammabhave kariyamāneti attho.
segments.vism17:654.22: Moho avijjāti yo tadā dukkhādīsu moho, yena mūḷho kammaṃ karoti, sā avijjā.
segments.vism17:654.23: Āyūhanā saṅkhārāti taṃ kammaṃ karoto yā purimacetanāyo, yathā ‘‘dānaṃ dassāmī’’ti cittaṃ uppādetvā māsampi saṃvaccharampi dānupakaraṇāni sajjentassa uppannā purimacetanāyo.
segments.vism17:654.24: Paṭiggāhakānaṃ pana hatthe dakkhiṇaṃ patiṭṭhāpayato cetanā bhavoti vuccati.
segments.vism17:654.25: Ekāvajjanesu vā chasu javanesu cetanā āyūhanā saṅkhārā nāma.
segments.vism17:654.27: Yā kāci vā pana cetanā bhavo.
segments.vism17:654.29: Nikanti taṇhāti yā kammaṃ karontassa phale upapattibhave nikāmanā patthanā, sā taṇhā nāma.
segments.vism17:654.30: Upagamanaṃ upādānanti yaṃ kammabhavassa paccayabhūtaṃ ‘‘idaṃ katvā asukasmiṃ nāma ṭhāne kāme sevissāmi ucchijjissāmī’’tiādinā nayena pavattaṃ upagamanaṃ gahaṇaṃ parāmasanaṃ, idaṃ upādānaṃ nāma.
segments.vism17:654.31: Cetanā bhavoti āyūhanāvasāne vuttā cetanā bhavoti evamattho veditabbo.
segments.vism17:654.33: Yathāha – ‘‘idha paṭisandhi viññāṇaṃ, okkanti nāmarūpaṃ, pasādo āyatanaṃ, phuṭṭho phasso, vedayitaṃ vedanā, ime pañca dhammā idhūpapattibhavasmiṃ purekatassa kammassa paccayā’’ti (paṭi. 1.47).
segments.vism17:654.34: Tattha paṭisandhi viññāṇanti yaṃ bhavantarapaṭisandhānavasena uppannattā paṭisandhīti vuccati, taṃ viññāṇaṃ.
segments.vism17:654.35: Okkanti nāmarūpanti yā gabbhe rūpārūpadhammānaṃ okkanti āgantvā pavisanaṃ viya, idaṃ nāmarūpaṃ.
segments.vism17:654.37: Phuṭṭho phassoti yo ārammaṇaṃ phuṭṭho phusanto uppanno, ayaṃ phasso.
segments.vism17:654.38: Vedayitaṃ vedanāti yaṃ paṭisandhiviññāṇena vā saḷāyatanapaccayena vā phassena saha uppannaṃ vipākavedayitaṃ, sā vedanāti evamattho veditabbo.
segments.vism17:654.39: Idāni hetavo pañcāti taṇhādayo pāḷiyaṃ āgatā taṇhupādānabhavā.
segments.vism17:654.40: Bhave pana gahite tassa pubbabhāgā taṃsampayuttā vā saṅkhārā gahitāva honti.
segments.vism17:654.41: Taṇhupādānaggahaṇena ca taṃsampayuttā, yāya vā mūḷho kammaṃ karoti, sā avijjā gahitāva hotīti.
segments.vism17:654.43: Tenāha ‘‘idha paripakkattā āyatanānaṃ moho avijjā, āyūhanā saṅkhārā, nikanti taṇhā, upagamanaṃ upādānaṃ, cetanā bhavoti ime pañca dhammā idha kammabhavasmiṃ āyatiṃ paṭisandhiyā paccayā’’ti (paṭi. ma. 1.47).
segments.vism17:654.44: Tattha idha paripakkattā āyatanānanti paripakkāyatanassa kammakaraṇakāle sammoho dassito.
segments.vism17:654.49: Tenāha – ‘‘āyatiṃ paṭisandhi viññāṇaṃ, okkanti nāmarūpaṃ, pasādo āyatanaṃ, phuṭṭho phasso, vedayitaṃ vedanā, ime pañca dhammā āyatiṃ upapattibhavasmiṃ idha katassa kammassa paccayā’’ti (paṭi. ma. 1.47).
segments.vism17:654.51: Tivaṭṭamanavaṭṭhitaṃ bhamatīti ettha pana saṅkhārabhavā kammavaṭṭaṃ, avijjātaṇhupādānāni kilesavaṭṭaṃ, viññāṇanāmarūpasaḷāyatanaphassavedanā vipākavaṭṭanti imehi tīhi vaṭṭehi tivaṭṭamidaṃ bhavacakkaṃ yāva kilesavaṭṭaṃ na upacchijjati, tāva anupacchinnapaccayattā anavaṭṭhitaṃ punappunaṃ parivattanato bhamatiyevāti veditabbaṃ.
segments.vism17:655.4: Tattha yasmā kusalākusalaṃ kammaṃ avisesena samudayasaccanti saccavibhaṅge vuttaṃ, tasmā avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārāti avijjāya saṅkhārā dutiyasaccappabhavaṃ dutiyasaccaṃ.
segments.vism17:655.11: Jātiyā jarāmaraṇaṃ paṭhamasaccappabhavaṃ paṭhamasaccanti evaṃ tāvidaṃ saccappabhavato viññātabbaṃ yathārahaṃ.
segments.vism17:656.1: Yasmā panettha avijjā vatthūsu ca satte sammoheti, paccayo ca hoti saṅkhārānaṃ pātubhāvāya.
segments.vism17:656.2: Tathā saṅkhārā saṅkhatañca abhisaṅkharonti, paccayā ca honti viññāṇassa.
segments.vism17:656.3: Viññāṇampi vatthuñca paṭivijānāti, paccayo ca hoti nāmarūpassa.
segments.vism17:656.4: Nāmarūpampi aññamaññañca upatthambheti, paccayo ca hoti saḷāyatanassa.
segments.vism17:656.5: Saḷāyatanampi savisaye ca pavattati, paccayo ca hoti phassassa.
segments.vism17:656.6: Phassopi ārammaṇañca phusati, paccayo ca hoti vedanāya.
segments.vism17:656.7: Vedanāpi ārammaṇarasañca anubhavati, paccayo ca hoti taṇhāya.
segments.vism17:656.8: Taṇhāpi rajjanīye ca dhamme rajjati, paccayo ca hoti upādānassa.
segments.vism17:656.9: Upādānampi upādāniye ca dhamme upādiyati, paccayo ca hoti bhavassa.
segments.vism17:656.10: Bhavopi nānāgatīsu ca vikkhipati, paccayo ca hoti jātiyā.
segments.vism17:656.11: Jātipi khandhe ca janeti tesaṃ abhinibbattibhāvena pavattattā, paccayo ca hoti jarāmaraṇassa.
segments.vism17:656.12: Jarāmaraṇampi khandhānaṃ pākabhedabhāvañca adhitiṭṭhati, paccayo ca hoti bhavantarapātubhāvāya sokādīnaṃ adhiṭṭhānattā.
segments.vism17:656.13: Tasmā sabbapadesu dvedhā pavattikiccatopi idaṃ viññātabbaṃ yathārahaṃ.
segments.vism17:657.1: Yasmā cettha avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārāti idaṃ kārakadassananivāraṇaṃ.
segments.vism17:657.4: Nāmarūpapaccayā saḷāyatanantiādi attā passati…pe… vijānāti, phusati, vedayati, taṇhiyati, upādiyati, bhavati, jāyati, jīyati, mīyatītievamādidassananivāraṇaṃ.
segments.vism17:658.1: Yasmā panettha salakkhaṇasāmaññalakkhaṇavasena dhammānaṃ adassanato andho viya avijjā.
segments.vism17:658.7: Ghaṭṭanadukkhaṃ viya phassapaccayā vedanā, dukkhassa paṭikārābhilāso viya vedanāpaccayā taṇhā.
segments.vism17:658.12: Yasmā vā panettha avijjā appaṭipattimicchāpaṭipattibhāvena satte abhibhavati paṭalaṃ viya akkhīni.
segments.vism17:658.13: Tadabhibhūto ca bālo punabbhavikehi saṅkhārehi attānaṃ veṭheti kosakārakimi viya kosappadesehi.
segments.vism17:658.14: Saṅkhārapariggahitaṃ viññāṇaṃ gatīsu patiṭṭhaṃ labhati pariṇāyakapariggahito viya rājakumāro rajje.
segments.vism17:658.15: Upapattinimittaparikappanato viññāṇaṃ paṭisandhiyaṃ anekappakāraṃ nāmarūpaṃ abhinibbatteti māyākāro viya māyaṃ.
segments.vism17:658.16: Nāmarūpe patiṭṭhitaṃ saḷāyatanaṃ vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ pāpuṇāti subhūmiyaṃ patiṭṭhito vanappagumbo viya.
segments.vism17:658.17: Āyatanaghaṭṭanato phasso jāyati araṇisahitābhimanthanato aggi viya.
segments.vism17:658.18: Phassena phuṭṭhassa vedanā pātubhavati agginā phuṭṭhassa dāho viya.
segments.vism17:658.19: Vedayamānassa taṇhā pavaḍḍhati loṇūdakaṃ pivato pipāsā viya.
segments.vism17:658.20: Tasito bhavesu abhilāsaṃ karoti pipāsito viya pānīye.
segments.vism17:658.21: Tadassupādānaṃ, upādānena bhavaṃ upādiyati āmisalobhena maccho baḷisaṃ viya.
segments.vism17:658.22: Bhave sati jāti hoti bīje sati aṅkuro viya.
segments.vism17:658.23: Jātassa avassaṃ jarāmaraṇaṃ uppannassa rukkhassa patanaṃ viya.
segments.vism17:659.1: Yasmā ca bhagavatā atthatopi dhammatopi desanatopi paṭivedhatopi gambhīrabhāvaṃ sandhāya ‘‘gambhīro cāyaṃ, ānanda, paṭiccasamuppādo gambhīrāvabhāso cā’’ti (dī. ni. 2.95; saṃ. ni. 2.60) vuttaṃ, tasmā gambhīrabhedatopetaṃ bhavacakkaṃ viññātabbaṃ yathārahaṃ.
segments.vism17:659.2: Tattha yasmā na jātito jarāmaraṇaṃ na hoti, na ca jātiṃ vinā aññato hoti, itthañca jātito samudāgacchatīti evaṃ jātipaccayasamudāgataṭṭhassa duravabodhanīyato jarāmaraṇassa jātipaccayasambhūtasamudāgataṭṭho gambhīro.
segments.vism17:659.3: Tathā jātiyā bhavapaccaya…pe… saṅkhārānaṃ avijjāpaccayasambhūtasamudāgataṭṭho gambhīro.
segments.vism17:659.4: Tasmā idaṃ bhavacakkaṃ atthagambhīranti ayaṃ tāvettha atthagambhīratā.
segments.vism17:659.7: Yasmā pana yenākārena yadavatthā ca avijjā tesaṃ tesaṃ saṅkhārānaṃ paccayo hoti, tassa duravabodhanīyato avijjāya saṅkhārānaṃ paccayaṭṭho gambhīro.
segments.vism17:659.8: Tathā saṅkhārānaṃ…pe… jātiyā jarāmaraṇassa paccayaṭṭho gambhīro, tasmā idaṃ bhavacakkaṃ dhammagambhīranti ayamettha dhammagambhīratā.
segments.vism17:659.11: Yasmā cassa tena tena kāraṇena tathā tathā pavattetabbattā desanāpi gambhīrā, na tattha sabbaññutaññāṇato aññaṃ ñāṇaṃ patiṭṭhaṃ labhati.
segments.vism17:659.12: Tathāhetaṃ katthaci sutte anulomato, katthaci paṭilomato, katthaci anulomapaṭilomato, katthaci vemajjhato paṭṭhāya anulomato vā paṭilomato vā, katthaci tisandhicatusaṅkhepaṃ, katthaci dvisandhitisaṅkhepaṃ, katthaci ekasandhidvisaṅkhepaṃ desitaṃ, tasmā idaṃ bhavacakkaṃ desanāgambhīranti ayaṃ desanāgambhīratā.
segments.vism17:659.13: Yasmā cettha yo so avijjādīnaṃ sabhāvo, yena paṭividdhena avijjādayo sammā salakkhaṇato paṭividdhā honti, so duppariyogāhattā gambhīro, tasmā idaṃ bhavacakkaṃ paṭivedhagambhīraṃ.
segments.vism17:659.14: Tathā hettha avijjāya aññāṇādassanasaccāsampaṭivedhaṭṭho gambhīro, saṅkhārānaṃ abhisaṅkharaṇāyūhanasarāgavirāgaṭṭho, viññāṇassa suññataabyāpāraasaṅkantipaṭisandhipātubhāvaṭṭho, nāmarūpassa ekuppādavinibbhogāvinibbhoganamanaruppanaṭṭho, saḷāyatanassa adhipatilokadvārakhettavisayibhāvaṭṭho, phassassa phusanasaṅghaṭṭanasaṅgatisannipātaṭṭho, vedanāya ārammaṇarasānubhavanasukhadukkhamajjhattabhāvanijjīvavedayitaṭṭho.
segments.vism17:659.15: Taṇhāya abhinanditajjhosānasaritālatānadītaṇhāsamuddaduppūraṭṭho, upādānassa ādānaggahaṇābhinivesaparāmāsaduratikkamaṭṭho, bhavassa āyūhanābhisaṅkharaṇayonigatiṭhitinivāsesukhipanaṭṭho, jātiyā jāti sañjāti okkanti nibbatti pātubhāvaṭṭho, jarāmaraṇassa khayavayabhedavipariṇāmaṭṭho gambhīroti ayamettha paṭivedhagambhīratā.
segments.vism17:660.1: Yasmā panettha ekattanayo, nānattanayo, abyāpāranayo, evaṃdhammatānayoti cattāro atthanayā honti, tasmā nayabhedatopetaṃ bhavacakkaṃ viññātabbaṃ yathārahaṃ.
segments.vism17:660.2: Tattha avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā, saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇanti evaṃ bījassa aṅkurādibhāvena rukkhabhāvappatti viya santānānupacchedo ekattanayo nāma.
segments.vism17:660.3: Yaṃ sammā passanto hetuphalasambandhena santānassa anupacchedāvabodhato ucchedadiṭṭhiṃ pajahati.
segments.vism17:660.4: Micchā passanto hetuphalasambandhena pavattamānassa santānānupacchedassa ekattagahaṇato sassatadiṭṭhiṃ upādiyati.
segments.vism17:660.6: Yaṃ sammā passanto navanavānaṃ uppādadassanato sassatadiṭṭhiṃ pajahati.
segments.vism17:660.7: Micchā passanto ekasantānapatitassa bhinnasantānasseva nānattaggahaṇato ucchedadiṭṭhiṃ upādiyati.
segments.vism17:660.8: Avijjāya saṅkhārā mayā uppādetabbā, saṅkhārānaṃ vā viññāṇaṃ amhehīti evamādibyāpārābhāvo abyāpāranayo nāma.
segments.vism17:660.9: Yaṃ sammā passanto kārakassa abhāvāvabodhato attadiṭṭhiṃ pajahati.
segments.vism17:660.10: Micchā passanto yo asatipi byāpāre avijjādīnaṃ sabhāvaniyamasiddho hetubhāvo, tassa aggahaṇato akiriyadiṭṭhiṃ upādiyati.
segments.vism17:660.11: Avijjādīhi pana kāraṇehi saṅkhārādīnaṃyeva sambhavo khīrādīhi dadhiādīnaṃ viya, na aññesanti ayaṃ evaṃdhammatānayo nāma.
segments.vism17:660.12: Yaṃ sammā passanto paccayānurūpato phalāvabodhā ahetukadiṭṭhiṃ akiriyadiṭṭhiñca pajahati.
segments.vism17:660.13: Micchā passanto paccayānurūpaṃ phalappavattiṃ aggahetvā yato kutoci yassa kassaci asambhavaggahaṇato ahetukadiṭṭhiñceva niyatavādañca upādiyatīti evamidaṃ bhavacakkaṃ,
segments.vism17:661.6: Vuttampi hetaṃ bhagavatā – ‘‘gambhīro cāyaṃ, ānanda, paṭiccasamuppādo gambhīrāvabhāso ca.
segments.vism17:661.7: Etassa cānanda, dhammassa ananubodhā appaṭivedhā evamayaṃ pajā tantākulakajātā kulāgaṇṭhikajātā muñjapabbajabhūtā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ saṃsāraṃ nātivattatī’’ti (mahāva. 95; saṃ. ni. 2.60).
